tema: O vulto do milharal a narração faça em inglês
legenda: Nunca corte caminho por lugares abandonados à noite. O que você faria se ficasse cara a cara com esse vulto? 🌽 Deixe sua resposta nos comentários! #terror #suspense #historiasdeterror #animacao
falas: Taking the shortcut across the cursed cornfield at midnight was the worst mistake of my life.
The rustling dry stalks suddenly froze into dead silence, and an icy breath touched my neck.
I raised my flickering flashlight and saw a tall, unnatural silhouette standing perfectly still between rows.
My trembling feet bolted forward, but every single path led me straight back to that watcher.
A soft, mocking whisper echoed through the rustling husks, calling my real name from all directions.
I tripped on old roots, dropped my light, and looked up into two glowing white eyes.
It reached out a long hand toward me; would you freeze in terror or run for your life?
